task_instance: Prep for a call with 'Figma' where the user supplied only the company name and no attendee list, following the skill's Steps 1-5 (identify account/attendees, account research via Common Room, contact research via Common Room, synthesize talking points, and a web-search recency check).
blocker_detail: The skill's core deliverable is a call-prep brief built primarily from 'Common Room signals' (Steps 2 and 3: account research and contact research run through the Common Room product/connector). This office-assistant runtime grants only text file read/write/edit and public web fetch/search - it has no Common Room connector or any CRM/signal-platform access, and per the task rules I could not call any MCP/connector tool or fabricate/stub the data Common Room would have returned. Without Common Room data there is no account snapshot, opportunity/renewal status, risk signals, activity history, or contact/Spark persona data to synthesize talking points, objections, or a recommended outcome from - the skill explicitly forbids generating a full brief or inventing such details from sparse/absent data. Separately, the skill's own reference files (references/call-types-guide.md and references/my-company-context.md) are also not present alongside SKILL.md in this benchmark checkout, so Step 4's company-context tailoring and the call-type-specific guidance could not be consulted either way. Only Step 5 (web-search recency check on the company) and the sparse-data honest-output fallback the skill itself specifies could actually be produced.
evidence: Read SKILL.md at /home/user/skill-achievability-compiler/benchmark/ce_sources_gr/anthropics__knowledge-work-plugins__call-prep/SKILL.md and confirmed only SKILL.md and LICENSE exist in that directory (referenced files under references/ are missing).
